A full-day excursion to the Atacama Salt Flat, the highland lagoons and Socaire.
Visit the high-altitude Miscanti and Miñiques lagoons.
Enjoy lunch in Socaire, a picturesque village located 100 km southeast of San Pedro de Atacama.
The journey then continues to the Atacama Salt Flat (Salar de Atacama), where you will visit Chaxa Lagoon and Los Flamencos National Reserve. Here you can observe three of the six flamingo species found in the world.
Next, the excursion takes you to the village of Toconao to visit San Lucas Church and the Campanario bell tower.
Return to San Pedro de Atacama.

lead: In the afternoon, explore Moon Valley (Valle de la Luna), located in the Cordillera de la Sal within
  Los Flamencos National Reserve. Salt ridges, sand dunes and striking rock formations shaped by wind and water over
  millions of years make the landscape look remarkably like the surface of the Moon. Walk through the valley and watch
  the sunset from a viewpoint as the rocks turn shades of red, orange and purple. Return to the hotel.

Take a boat to two of the twelve villages around Lake Atitlán. The first stop is San Juan La Laguna, home to the Tz'utujil Maya. Your visit introduces you to the community's local culture, natural surroundings and traditional way of life.

The journey continues to Santiago Atitlán. Residents make their living through fishing and crafts, and the town is known for its veneration of Maximón, a deity blending Maya and Catholic traditions. After the excursion, return to Lake Atitlán.
